label: System Design
description: Design architecture, modules, APIs, ownership boundaries, or technical approach.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for design, architecture, plans, or tradeoff analysis.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for direct implementation with known design.

label: Architecture Review
description: Review a design or implementation for architecture and long-term maintainability.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a system shape, API, or module boundary is sound.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: The review is primarily about code-level bugs or security risk.

label: Technical Plan
description: Produce a technical implementation plan, phases, or tradeoff analysis.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to approach implementation before coding.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to directly edit files now.

label: API Design
description: Design public APIs, contracts, schemas, or integration boundaries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for API shape, schema, protocol, or backwards compatibility.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to debug a runtime failure.

label: Infrastructure Design
description: Design infrastructure topology, deployment units, or service boundaries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for infra architecture or environment design.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to execute deployment commands.

label: Data Model Design
description: Design entities, schemas, data ownership, and persistence boundaries.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for data model or storage architecture.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for SQL query implementation only.

label: Integration Plan
description: Plan how systems, APIs, events, and services should integrate.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to connect systems or design integration flow.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to debug one failed API call.

label: Scalability Review
description: Review scalability, bottlenecks, throughput, and growth tradeoffs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether a system will scale.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for visual UI review.

label: Migration Strategy
description: Plan migrations across systems, data stores, APIs, or platforms.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to migrate safely with stages and rollback.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to edit a small file directly.

label: Architecture Decision Record
description: Write or review ADRs and architectural decision rationale.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to document a technical decision.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for public marketing copy.
